title: Project Aurex Ascendancy — The 9.9 Initiative

owner_clarification.supersedes: Any earlier statement in this file that treats THE BIG ONE as a fixed architecture or as an archive of proprietary algorithms.
owner_clarification.dataset_role: THE BIG ONE is the real-company industrial audit validation dataset.
owner_clarification.handling: Raw company records and sensitive metadata were not read, hashed, uploaded, committed, or transmitted. Processing them requires a human authorization and a read-only no-export privacy control. The current engine admits SYNTHETIC_ONLY, so an authorized historical digest is recorded and then left NOT_PROCESSED rather than relabeled as synthetic.
owner_clarification.kernel_boundary: aurex/ascendancy does not encode that company's columns, names, or file layout. Onboarding uses a caller-supplied header map.

mathematical_specification.M1: Disjoint evidence-root count from aurex.evidence_kernel. A record-count baseline is reported only for comparison.
mathematical_specification.M2: Fixed log likelihood: log(0.9) per correct label and log(0.1) per incorrect label. Optional BIC penalty k*log(n)/2 in nats.
mathematical_specification.M3: Exact Decimal sums, string identity, and detection of two different totals for one subject.
mathematical_specification.M4: Closed date intervals. A successor retires only the named predecessor. The old record remains in the input history.
mathematical_specification.M5: An independence claim survives only when the root count meets the required number. corrupt_decimal adds a nonzero cent and does not rewrite the source.
mathematical_specification.M6: Canonical JSON SHA-256 over inputs, outputs, financial_authority NONE, and production HOLD.

financial_oracle.ledger: 36 monthly synthetic jobs, one flat rate, one hourly equipment job, one hourly labor job
financial_oracle.arithmetic: 150-100=50 flat over; 4.00*25.00=100 and 150-100=50 hour over with 9 standby hours excluded; partial 100-40=60; reversal net 60 against paid 100 leaves 40; misapplied 100 counted once; duplicate invoices withhold 200
